# Attack surface inventory — testphp.vulnweb.com

**Scan mode:** black-box recon only (benign requests). No injection, no scanners, no brute force.
**Live status:** HOST UNREACHABLE from this environment. Inventory below is split into **observed** vs **unconfirmed historical** (well-known Acunetix demo map). Do not treat historical paths as live-confirmed.

## Hosts (observed)

- **FQDN:** `testphp.vulnweb.com`
- **A record:** `44.228.249.3` (confirmed via default resolver, 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1)
- **AAAA:** none
- **CNAME:** none
- **PTR / AWS hint:** `ec2-44-228-249-3.us-west-2.compute.amazonaws.com` (from `nc` banner on connect attempt)
- **In-scope only:** this host. No other domains probed.

## Reachability (observed)

- **TCP 80:** connection timed out (direct `nc`/`curl --noproxy`, and via Caido proxy)
- **TCP 443:** connection timed out (same)
- **TCP 8080 / 8443:** nmap `-Pn --open` returned no open ports (2.3s, no service lines)
- **ICMP:** 3/3 packet loss
- **nmap without `-Pn`:** host appears down
- **HTTP via proxy:** Caido `502` with `c-details: Timeout` (proxy error page, not origin)
- **HTTPS via proxy:** same `502 Timeout`
- **Fingerprint, crawl, dirbust, JS harvest, form/param inventory:** not executed against origin because TCP never completed.

## Tech / cookies / security headers (observed)

- **None from origin.** No Server/PHP version, Set-Cookie, CSP, HSTS, WAF, or TLS cert could be read.
- Proxy 502 pages are Caido, not the target.

## Auth requirement (observed)

- Unknown. No session cookies, login responses, or role gates observed.

## Endpoints / forms / params — LIVE: none captured

Cannot list live method+params+auth. Origin never answered.

## Unconfirmed historical surface (Acunetix “testphp” demo — NOT live-verified this scan)

Use only as hunter starting hypotheses if connectivity is restored. Paths commonly documented for this host:

**Pages (GET, typically unauthenticated on the demo):**
- `/` `/index.php`
- `/login.php` — login form
- `/signup.php` — registration
- `/userinfo.php` — profile after login
- `/logout.php`
- `/artists.php` — `artist` (numeric object id)
- `/listproducts.php` — `cat`
- `/product.php` — `pic`
- `/categories.php`
- `/search.php` — search query param (often `searchFor` / `goButton`)
- `/guestbook.php` — comments/guestbook
- `/comment.php`
- `/cart.php`
- `/AJAX/` `/AJAX/index.php` — AJAX demo
- `/hpp/` — HTTP Parameter Pollution demo (`pp`)
- `/Flash/` — flash demo
- `/htaccess/` — htaccess demo
- `/Mod_Rewrite_Shop/` — rewritten shop URLs
- `/showimage.php` — `file` (classic LFI/file-read candidate)
- `/redir.php` or similar redirect helpers (`rurl`) — unconfirmed name
- `/privacy.php` `/disclaimer.php`
- `/admin/` `/secured/` — sometimes present on the demo
- `/style.css` `/Templates/` static

**Forms (historical, not captured):**
- Login: POST `/login.php` fields `uname`, `pass` (no CSRF token historically)
- Signup: POST `/signup.php` (username/password/name/etc.)
- Search: GET/POST `/search.php`
- Guestbook: POST `/guestbook.php` (name, comment, etc.)
- Cart/add-to-cart: product id params

**Query/body params of hunter interest (historical):**
- `artist`, `cat`, `pic` — object IDs (IDOR)
- `file` on `showimage.php` — LFI/path traversal
- search fields — SQLi/XSS
- guestbook/comment fields — stored XSS / SQLi
- `pp` on `/hpp/` — HPP
- login `uname`/`pass` — SQLi auth bypass (demo is famous for this)
- AJAX endpoints — extra params

**Default/demo credentials (historical, printed on the demo login page in past copies; NOT brute-forced, NOT confirmed live):**
- Often shown as `test` / `test`

**JS:** not enumerated (no crawl).

## Interesting headers

- None from origin.

## Observed roles

- None. Unauthenticated vs logged-in split not mapped.

## Artifacts

- `/workspace/recon/nmap_web.nmap` (empty open-port set)
- DNS: `44.228.249.3` only

c8527f.title: Auth and session model
c8527f.content:
# Auth and session model — testphp.vulnweb.com

**Live status:** Origin TCP 80/443 timed out from this environment (direct and via proxy). No login, signup, logout, cookies, or CSRF tokens were observed on a live response.

## Observed this scan
- No Set-Cookie from origin
- No login/signup/logout responses
- No CSRF token presence/absence confirmed
- Cookie flags (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite) unknown
- Roles (anonymous vs logged-in) unknown

## Historical (NOT live-verified)
- Demo typically exposes `/login.php` (POST `uname`, `pass`), `/signup.php`, `/logout.php`, `/userinfo.php`
- Session historically via PHPSESSID-style cookie; CSRF historically absent
- Demo login page has often displayed credentials `test` / `test` — not confirmed live, not brute-forced

Do not treat historical notes as confirmed until connectivity is restored.
